prompt: Official Campaign Platform for Ernest Trevino for Atascosa County Sheriff

profile.name: Ernest Trevino for Atascosa County Sheriff
profile.hours: Campaign Office: Mon - Sat: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
profile.tagline: Honest Leadership. Safer Communities. Stronger Atascosa County.
profile.description: With over 28 years of law enforcement experience, Ernest Trevino is committed to protecting and serving every citizen of Atascosa County with integrity, fairness, professionalism, and respect. No longer government for a select few.

services.title: Priority #1: Protect Our Kids
services.description: Ensure all county officers are cross-trained and ready for active shooters in schools or any location. We will work to protect the future of our children and generations to come.

services.title: Trevino for Transparency
services.description: Restoring trust through transparent leadership, equal treatment, responsible use of public resources, and consistent accountability. We will reject favoritism and build a professional workplace.

services.title: Deep Roots. Strong Values.
services.description: For over a century and a half, the Trevino family has lived, worked, and served in Atascosa County as landowners, farmers, ranchers, and public servants. Ernest honors that legacy.

testimonials.quote: Assisted in the Atascosa Ambush and received the SAPD Medal of Valor, Texas Governor's Medal of Valor, and DPS Director's Award.
testimonials.author: Medal of Valor Recipient

testimonials.quote: Served as an ROP Detective involved in 165 high-risk felony search warrants. Joint work with federal agencies contributed to 1,473 felony suspect arrests and over $100 million in seizures.
testimonials.author: Undercover ROP Detective

testimonials.quote: Supervised over 3,200 sworn officers and 400 civilian personnel, managing a $150 million budget environment for the San Antonio Police Department.
testimonials.author: Patrol Division Command
